answer_1.quote: We evaluate RULE on three medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) and report generation benchmarks... For Med-VQA task, we use Accuracy... For report generation task, we use BLEU Score, ROUGE-L and METEOR.
answer_1.outputs: Medical answers to VQA questions and radiology report texts

answer_2.quote: For Med-VQA task, we use Accuracy as the primary metric and also adopt Precision, Recall, and F1 Score. For report generation task, we use BLEU Score, ROUGE-L and METEOR.
